departure_checklist.title: Use a DMW-licensed recruitment agency
departure_checklist.description: Check the agency's licence with the Department of Migrant Workers before paying anything.

departure_checklist.title: Get a written contract you understand
departure_checklist.description: Compare the contract with what the agency promised before you sign.

departure_checklist.title: Overseas Employment Certificate
departure_checklist.description: Departing workers need their exit clearance processed through the DMW.

departure_checklist.title: Pre-Departure Orientation Seminar
departure_checklist.description: Attend the orientation; it covers your rights and contacts abroad.
